counting_rule: Only explicit substantive source-analysis ranges count. Union is deduplicated by path/range; source reads/searches/inventory alone do not count. Independent security verification reports are retained separately and do not inflate this ledger. Full-file review does not imply completed module or runtime validation.
status_rule: REVIEWED is completed source review of the package files; VERIFIED would additionally require independent completion of scope and critical findings. No package is marked VERIFIED in this checkpoint. Partial work in the blocked session/protocol lane is recorded only when independently reread in the lead ledger.
